claims.text: Baseline/treatment trade counts and forced/midband/max-hold counters match summary/exit_attribution/metrics.
Trade-count rise 109→566 explained by earlier exits on shared entries plus short-side re-entry churn (458 T-only shorts).
forced_exits=326 vs ledger signal exits=320; gap=6 not trade-grain proven.
Cost-drag increase exceeds gross-PnL improvement and accounts for net degradation.
Short-side net delta dominates degradation; long-side improved.
11 baseline end_of_data winners truncated to signal exits with large negative shared-pair net delta.
55 stop_loss→signal shared pairs improve net (positive delta), offsetting part of truncation loss.
T-only re-entry trades carry large fee+slippage cost and negative net contribution.
Max-hold class is small and proxy economics are positive.
No committed regime/volatility bucket fields in V6 ledgers/metrics.
Cannot prove unfinished mean-reversion path without raw panel/bar reconstruction (forbidden).
Earliest evidenced causal boundary is forced exit eligibility / forced midband-or-maxhold exit, then re-entry and cost aggregation.
Degradation is mixed: short-side broad churn plus concentrated instrument losers (APE/ENS/MANA/LUNA/EGLD).
